goal: Author, strictly from the supplied format specification, a python encoder encode(d: dict) -> str, and independently report any behavior the specification leaves undetermined over the supplied probe inputs. Terminal worker; no delegation.

nodes.instructions: Read format.md (the specification) and probes.json (the input maps to be encoded). Acquire the specification and the inputs only; decide nothing about correctness yet. These two files are the ONLY inputs; no reference implementation exists in your workspace and none may be assumed.
nodes.why_necessary: The encoder and the undetermined-behavior report are both functions of the specification text and the probe inputs; that evidence must be acquired as a distinct step first.

nodes.instructions: Write clean_impl.py exposing encode(d: dict) -> str that implements exactly and only what format.md states. Where format.md does not fully determine the output for some input the probes exercise (e.g. a rule the text does not give), make one good-faith reading, implement it, and record that behavior verbatim in an undetermined_behaviors list. Do not invent rules to match any imagined reference; implement the spec as written and flag its gaps honestly.
nodes.why_necessary: This node produces E-B (the mechanically runnable encoder) and the child's independent E-A (behaviors the spec leaves undetermined) from the specification alone.

nodes.instructions: Re-read clean_impl.py against format.md: confirm encode(d: dict) -> str exists, that every rule implemented is traceable to a sentence in format.md, and that no undocumented behavior was added beyond the flagged good-faith readings. Record the structural check outcome. Non-authoritative.
nodes.why_necessary: The child contract requires the verify primitive in any Write-holding topology; a structural self-check before return is the minimal fulfilment.

nodes.instructions: Write child-result.json referencing the encoder file and listing the undetermined behaviors, and finalize the child ledger with a terminating complete event. Return clean_impl.py and child-result.json as the deliverables.
nodes.why_necessary: The child's evidence must re-enter the boundary through a defined return locus; without it the encoder never becomes available for integration.

ledger_contract.schema: normalized formal event schema: one JSON object per line with event_id, label, actor, timestamp, artifact_refs, metadata; node executions carry metadata.completes_node; closed kernel alphabet with metadata.event_kind refinements
